title: 'No NALSAR 2026 graduate will be advocate': BCI's strong stand amid CJI invite row
content: The Bar Council of India has put a pause on NALSAR's enrollments for the 2026 law graduates. This decision comes in the wake of an alleged smear campaign against Chief Justice Surya Kant's presence at the convocation. The Council demands a comprehensive report from NALSAR within three days, requiring identification of those behind this campaign. The situation will be reviewed on August 19, 2026.

title: 'No clear info': Nepal PM claims Indian territory, but 'loses' 210-year-old treaty papers
content: Nepal's foreign minister announced that the country might have misplaced the original Sugauli Treaty papers, which played a critical role in establishing its borders with British India after the Anglo-Nepalese War. This comes at a time when border disputes with India have intensified. The government plans to systematically assess numerous international agreements, seeking to amend or renew any that are no longer pertinent.

title: Sri Lankan coach dies after altercation with cricketer in Colombo
content: Tragic news strikes the cricket community as veteran coach Sumith Fernando passes away at 62 following a violent altercation. The incident, which took place on August 8 at a Colombo cricket facility, started over a dispute regarding drinking water. A 17-year-old player has been arrested in connection with this troubling event. Fernando was well-known for his role in mentoring Sri Lanka's ODI captain, Kusal Mendis.

title: India’s critical mineral push: Govt plans processing parks in 4 states
content: India is set to establish four specialized parks dedicated to critical mineral processing, targeting lithium and nickel first. The initiative, spearheaded by state governments with central technical assistance, is aligned with the National Critical Mineral Mission aimed at bolstering self-reliance. This move is crucial in propelling India’s transition toward green energy, ensuring a sustainable future.

title: Google co-founder’s a message for DeepMind staff after Demis Hassabis exits as CEO
content: Google co-founder Sergey Brin has been urging Google DeepMind staff to go all in on Gemini and catch up to the AI frontier, following a sweeping leadership overhaul that saw Demis Hassabis step aside as CEO. Koray Kavukcuoglu now runs day-to-day operations from Mountain View, with final say on major decisions. The reshuffle follows Gemini release delays, coding benchmark gaps against Anthropic and OpenAI, and high-profile exits including Jeff Dean.

title: 'Stop being a princess': Crowd targets Steve Smith over sight screen delay
content: During a pause in the Test match, Steve Smith was met with a witty remark from a fan, adding some levity to the situation. Australia had a tough start, dismissed for just 198 runs, while Hasan Mahmud shone with a six-wicket haul, marking his career best. Bangladesh made a strong reply, finishing the day at 96 for one and reducing Australia's lead to 102 runs.

title: Months after Dells' $6.25bn ‘gift’, US Treasury sets new Trump Account paycheck rules
content: Under the new guidelines for Trump Accounts, both employers and employees can make contributions towards payrolls. Employers are permitted to add up to $2,500 annually without tax for dependent children, while employees can contribute pre-tax funds directly from their paychecks. In support of this initiative, Michael and Susan Dell committed $6.25 billion to boost child savings. The proposal is currently open for public feedback prior to its finalization.

title: 'PM Modi does not sleep at night, Amit Shah has disappeared': Rahul mocks Centre
content: Rahul Gandhi firmly asserted that the Congress party's primary function is to enhance the expression of India’s citizens. He articulated concerns about the government's tendencies to silence dissent and manipulate information. Furthermore, Gandhi lambasted the government’s foreign policy strategies and the failure of the RSS to comprehend the complexities of contemporary Indian society.

title: Mississippi teen became a CPA at 15 after finishing high school at 12

Displaying an exceptional intellect, he completed both his bachelor's and master’s degrees by the age of 15 and became the youngest Certified Public Accountant in history.

title: Meet Scarlett Tiani, student behind an award-winning dog safety invention

Designed to enhance safety during unexpected dog interactions, Tiani's creation received numerous accolades at the prestigious national Invention Convention. With legal support at her side, she is now set to embark on the journey of securing a U.S. patent for her groundbreaking invention.

title: Trump memo to govt organisations: Tap vetted private tech firms to join cyber ops

This collaboration focuses on executing proactive cyber operations against foreign criminal networks. Such a partnership enhances the government's ability to dismantle global criminal organizations. Supervised private firms will engage in focused cyber initiatives, aiming to effectively combat cybercrime through innovation and specialized resources from the private sector.

title: Aaradhya case: Delhi HC asks how far a famous family name’s reputation extends

It will also consider if fake news violates intellectual property rights.  The case explores defamation within intellectual property law frameworks.  The matter will be heard again on September fifteenth.

title: New York’s pied-à-terre tax explained: Which luxury homes could face an extra bill?

The four-time Grand Slam champion explained that fashion has pushed her outside her introverted comfort zone and helped her meet people from unfamiliar worlds. After reaching the Wimbledon quarterfinals, Osaka now turns toward hard courts, where she has won all four Grand Slam titles. Her upcoming North American swing could prove crucial for her season.

title: Randy Orton vs. John Cena: Who had the more iconic WWE career?

title: Sacked Delhi Police constable held for killing of 10 leopards in Kuno National Park

Eight individuals have already been detained, and the ongoing investigation seeks to explore any connections between the NGO and the poaching incidents.

title: UP polls: How parties are vying for Dalit votes amid Mayawati’s shrinking base

The Bharatiya Janata Party and the Samajwadi Party are actively courting Dalit voters ahead of elections, and the Congress party is also working to regain its historic connections. Meanwhile, Chandrashekhar Azad is establishing a distinct political identity, foreshadowing a significant shift in the Dalit electoral landscape.

title: RG Kar case: How mobile trail led Bengal cops to ex-TMC MLA Nirmal Ghosh in Odisha hotel

title: Halley’s Comet takes about 76 years to orbit the Sun and will return to our skies in 2061
content: Halley's Comet will next reach its closest point to the Sun in July 2061. This famous comet completes its orbit around the Sun approximately every 76 years. Its previous visit occurred in 1986, and the next is expected in 2134. The comet's debris creates the Eta Aquarids and Orionids meteor showers annually. Future missions will investigate Halley's composition and structure upon its return.

title: Bengal strips BJP MP Ananta Maharaj of state honour over remarks 'insulting' Netaji
